title: UN Commission finding on siege and starvation in Gaza
affected_population: Palestinian civilians in the Gaza Strip
summary: The Commission assessed restrictions on goods indispensable to civilian survival during the period through 31 December 2023.
claim: The Commission found that Israeli authorities used starvation as a method of warfare through a total siege that cut off supplies essential for civilian life, including water, food, electricity, fuel and humanitarian assistance.
legal_characterization: War-crime finding by a UN commission of inquiry; not a court judgment or final determination of state or individual criminal responsibility.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against the cited paragraphs of A/HRC/56/26 and the Commission methodology in paragraphs 3-7, including its reasonable-grounds standard. This is attributed to the Commission and is not a court judgment or an individual conviction.
